name: Forced Disarmament
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.
narrative.objectives: Collect 30 Dragonmaw Armaments in Dragonmaw Retreat, then bring them to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.
